name: print-social-pixel-icon-topic-grid-post-on-cobalt-with-script-labels
title: Cobalt grainy post with six pixel-art topic icons, script labels, glitter starbursts and a yellow pill
whatItIs: A grainy cobalt post with a yellow rounded title, six pixel-art icons (Netflix, dress, phone, cookie heart, piggy bank, van) with white script labels below, glitter starbursts and sparkles in the corners and a yellow pill with dark green text at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Cute and inviting; pixel icons make topics feel like game items.
techniques: Show topics as pixel-art icons in a 2x3 grid.

vocabulary.definition: Pixel-art items arranged in a grid.
A yellow capsule holding a line of text.
